**[Get WhisperShortcut on the Mac App Store](https://whispershortcut.com/go/appstore?src=github-release)** — automatic updates, one-time purchase.

## Live Meeting
- **A meeting survives an unplanned quit.** If the app quits or restarts while a meeting records, the part being recorded is kept. When the app starts again within 10 minutes, the same meeting resumes on its own and a notice says so. After that, a notice tells you the recording was interrupted, so a gap never goes unnoticed.

## Meetings in AI apps
- **One command for Claude Code.** Settings → Meetings → "Meetings in Claude & Other AI Apps" now copies a single command that replaces any earlier entry. Run it again after creating a new access key, then start a new Claude Code session.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v8.51...v8.52
